hunks.baseline: The sensation of passing through a magical field was more than familiar to a veteran Hunter like me. Even so, it was often unpleasant enough to make me shudder.
hunks.sol: As a veteran Hunter, I knew the sensation of passing through a magical field all too well. Even so, it was unpleasant enough to make me shudder every time.

hunks.baseline: Like right now.
hunks.sol: Like now.

hunks.baseline: The cold, sticky sensation unique to magical power wrapped around my entire body, then spat me out somewhere beyond.
hunks.sol: The cold, sticky sensation of magical power wrapped around my entire body, then spat me out somewhere on the other side.

hunks.baseline: The moment I opened my eyes in the new space, I realized something I’d never known before.
hunks.sol: The moment I opened my eyes in the new space, I realized something I hadn’t known before.

hunks.baseline: Branches packed so tightly they covered the sky. Steep hills.
The mountains of corpses and rivers of blood that had filled every direction were gone.
hunks.sol: The branches that had packed the sky were gone. So were the steep hills, the mountains of corpses, and the rivers of blood that had filled the landscape.

hunks.baseline: But it wasn’t only the surrounding scenery that had changed.
hunks.sol: But the scenery wasn’t the only thing that had changed.

hunks.baseline: That filthy energy should have fallen cleanly away the moment I left the Gate, but it was still clinging to my body.
hunks.sol: That filthy energy should have fallen away the moment I left the Gate. Instead, it was still clinging to my body.

hunks.baseline: No—it filled this entire space.
hunks.sol: No. It filled this entire space.

hunks.baseline: The heavy words slipped out like a groan.
hunks.sol: The words came out like a groan.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang, who had been shuddering at the magical field’s repulsive sensation, reacted at once when I fell silent.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang, who had been shuddering at the magical field’s repulsive sensation, reacted when I fell silent.

hunks.baseline: But the intense sense of déjà vu pressing in on all five senses since the moment I opened my eyes brought back memories from less than a few weeks ago. And Jeok Cheongang already knew most of the truth about me.
hunks.sol: But the déjà vu pressing in on all five senses brought back memories from only a few weeks ago. Besides, Jeok Cheongang already knew most of the truth about me.

hunks.baseline: And one being waiting for me in a dark castle newly raised above the blackened earth.
hunks.sol: And a being waiting for me in a dark castle newly raised above the blackened earth.

hunks.baseline: That was right.
hunks.sol: That was it.

hunks.baseline: An energy intense enough that you could call it the Demon Realm.
hunks.sol: Enough to make me think of the Demon Realm.

hunks.baseline: *No. It’s even worse.*
hunks.sol: *No. It’s even stronger.*

hunks.baseline: According to Jeok Cheongang, I’d been unconscious for about a day.
hunks.sol: According to Jeok Cheongang, I’d been unconscious for a little over a day.

hunks.baseline: I’d only felt magical power this pure after approaching a Dragon Lair, but already, energy nearly as powerful was churning all around us.
hunks.sol: I hadn’t felt magical power this pure until I approached Morgoth’s Dragon Lair. Here, power nearly as strong was already churning all around us.

hunks.baseline: All kinds of absurd rumors floated around Murim, but the stories about this damn mountain range had been watered down to an almost ridiculous degree.
hunks.sol: All kinds of absurd rumors floated around Murim, but if anything, the stories about this damn mountain range had understated the truth.

hunks.baseline: Only now, after seeing and feeling the Tianshan Mountains for myself, did I understand that they were a forbidden land in the truest sense—a Land of Ruin.
hunks.sol: Now that I’d seen and felt the Tianshan Mountains for myself, I knew they were a forbidden land. A Land of Ruin.

hunks.baseline: Uninvited guests who hadn’t received permission from its master shouldn’t enter—and couldn’t leave.
hunks.sol: Uninvited guests who hadn’t received their master’s permission shouldn’t enter—and couldn’t leave.

hunks.baseline: And this endless range of dark mountains showed no sign of revealing what it hid within its vast bulk.
hunks.sol: And this endless range of dark mountains showed no sign of revealing the secrets it hid within its vast bulk.

hunks.baseline: That included the mountains’ master—and the other uninvited guests besides Jeok Cheongang and me.
hunks.sol: Not its master. Not the other uninvited guests besides Jeok Cheongang and me.

hunks.baseline: “I suspected as much when we were caught by that strange thing, whatever it was called. Seems I was right.”
hunks.sol: “I suspected as much when that strange thing—whatever it was called—caught us. Seems I was right.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang narrowed his eyes at the mist drifting around us, but that didn’t make the missing people suddenly appear.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang glared at the mist drifting around us, but that didn’t make the missing people appear.

hunks.baseline: Even a superhuman with the eyesight to clearly make out an ant a hundred yards away couldn’t peer through the space between reality and a Gate with human eyes.
hunks.sol: Even a superhuman who could make out an ant over three hundred yards away couldn’t peer through the space between reality and a Gate with human eyes.

hunks.baseline: A thought suddenly crossed my mind, and I added silently,
hunks.sol: Then a thought crossed my mind.

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t be sure this idea would work.
Frankly, if I looked at the odds coldly, I was more likely to waste my energy and make things worse.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t be sure this idea would work. Frankly, the odds favored me wasting my strength and making things worse.

hunks.baseline: But when there’s only one path ahead—and you’ve already traveled it once—then no matter how huge an obstacle stands in the way, you have to smash through it and keep going.
hunks.sol: But when there’s only one path ahead, and you’ve already traveled it once, you have to smash through whatever stands in the way and keep going.

hunks.baseline: The air began to tremble. As I took a deep breath, I raised my spear.
hunks.sol: The air began to tremble. I took a deep breath and raised my spearhead.

hunks.baseline: Slowly enough to make someone yawn, I spread the energy coiled within me through my whole body.
hunks.sol: Slowly enough to make someone yawn, I spread the energy coiled within me through my entire body.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang reacted to this sudden move, but only for a moment. Then the entire area fell silent.
hunks.sol: I felt Jeok Cheongang react to the move, but only for a moment. Then everything around me fell silent.

hunks.baseline: More precisely, my concentration reached its peak and erased everything, even the irrelevant noise.
hunks.sol: More precisely, my concentration reached its peak and shut out everything I didn’t need, down to the slightest noise.

hunks.baseline: A thunderous ringing filled my ears. At the same moment, a terrible headache struck and whitened my vision.
hunks.sol: A ringing like thunder filled my ears. A terrible headache struck without warning, turning my vision white.

hunks.baseline: As I heard a clear chime ringing faintly somewhere, I realized my reckless attempt had finally succeeded.
hunks.sol: Somewhere, a clear chime rang faintly. I knew my reckless attempt had succeeded—and that I couldn’t let this fleeting opening slip away.

hunks.baseline: I also knew I couldn’t let this fleeting gap slip away after all that effort.
*Plip. Plip.*
hunks.sol: *Drip. Drip.*

hunks.baseline: Was it because the tiny blood vessels in my eyes had burst one by one? Or because blood had begun to seep between my lips without my even noticing?
hunks.sol: Had the tiny blood vessels in my eyes burst one by one? Or was it the blood slipping between my lips without my noticing?

hunks.baseline: My vision was red all over. Pain pierced my chest and brain.
hunks.sol: Everything I saw was red. Pain stabbed through my chest and brain.

hunks.baseline: But it didn’t matter.
hunks.sol: It didn’t matter.

hunks.baseline: I let out the breath I’d been holding and brought the spearhead, raised high above me, slashing down.
hunks.sol: I let out the breath I’d been holding and brought the spearhead slashing down from high above me.

hunks.baseline: Following the single path my other eye—the Mind’s Eye—had shown me.
hunks.sol: Along the single path my other eye—the Mind’s Eye—had shown me.

hunks.baseline: A blinding flash split the world—and the invisible veil.
hunks.sol: A blinding flash split the world. Split the invisible veil.

hunks.baseline: The first line of text to appear before Jin Taekyung’s eyes.
hunks.sol: That was the first line to appear before Jin Taekyung’s eyes.

hunks.baseline: It was the starting flare.
A flare announcing that a wave of System notifications was coming.
hunks.sol: The signal flare announcing a wave of System notifications.

hunks.baseline:
> **System**
> - Special ability **Mind’s Eye** has been activated because its activation conditions have been met!
> - Your insight into **Mind’s Eye** has deepened.
> - Always exercise caution. This ability can cause severe harm to the user’s mind and body, and in the worst case, can lead to death!
> - Status effect **Exhaustion** has been applied!
> - Status effect **Extreme Fatigue** has been applied!
> - Status effect **Internal Injury** has…
hunks.sol:
> **System**
> - Special ability **Mind’s Eye** has been activated because its activation conditions have been met!
> - Your insight into **Mind’s Eye** has deepened.
> - Always exercise caution. This ability can cause severe harm to the user’s mind and body, and in the worst case, death!
> - Status effect **Exhaustion** has been applied!
> - Status effect **Extreme Fatigue** has been applied!
> - Status effect **Internal Injury** has…

hunks.baseline: His chest felt tight. Nausea rose as his disoriented body swayed from side to side.
hunks.sol: His chest felt tight. Nausea rose, and his disoriented body swayed from side to side.

hunks.baseline: Through vision warped like a heat haze, he saw Jeok Cheongang rush up and catch him, shouting something. His battered senses could barely register the man’s words or touch.
hunks.sol: Through vision warped like a heat haze, he saw Jeok Cheongang rush up to support him, shouting something. His battered senses could barely register the man’s words or touch.

hunks.baseline: It had been a dangerous move, but the payoff was worth it.
hunks.sol: The attempt had been dangerous, but the payoff was worth it.

hunks.baseline: He’d gained all at once the EXP it would take to defeat several Black Ghosts—and, more importantly, achieved his main goal.
hunks.sol: He’d gained in one stroke the EXP it would have taken several Black Ghosts to earn. More importantly, he’d achieved his goal.

hunks.baseline: “Just like you see.”
hunks.sol: “You can see for yourself.”

hunks.baseline: The changes around us were already plain enough to see with the naked eye.
hunks.sol: The changes around them were already plain to the naked eye.

hunks.baseline: The empty air warped.
Like the face of a monster being forced to spit something out.
hunks.sol: The empty air warped, like the face of a monster forced to spit something out.

hunks.baseline: Several invisible gaps opened their maws one after another.
hunks.sol: Several previously invisible gaps opened their maws one after another.

hunks.baseline: They belched out the darkness that had filled them, along with something they’d hidden away.
hunks.sol: They spilled out the darkness that had filled them, along with what they’d hidden away.

hunks.baseline: “Arrrgh! You sons of bitches—you’re worse than beggars!”
hunks.sol: “Arrrgh! You sons of bitches aren’t even as good as beggars!”

hunks.baseline: “Come forth! I am Hyuk Mu—best hero the great Jin Family of Taiyuan has to offer!”
hunks.sol: “Come forth! I am Hyuk Mu—greatest hero the mighty Jin Family of Taiyuan has to offer!”

hunks.baseline: One beggar who didn’t hesitate to criticize himself, and one martial artist whose fierce loyalty to his family was matched only by his willingness to trade self-awareness for a piece of candy.
hunks.sol: A beggar who didn’t hesitate to insult his own kind, and a martial artist whose fierce devotion to his family had cost him every shred of self-awareness.

hunks.baseline: In the suffocating silence, the great Jin Family of Taiyuan’s best hero finally spoke.
hunks.sol: In the suffocating silence, the Jin Family of Taiyuan’s greatest hero finally spoke.

hunks.baseline: The beggar, who was just a little better than a son of a bitch, shot back.
hunks.sol: The beggar, who was a little better than a son of a bitch, shot back.

hunks.baseline: As the two traded words, Master and Disciple watched the whole thing with distant eyes and had nearly the same thought.
hunks.sol: Master and Disciple watched them with distant eyes and had much the same thought.

hunks.baseline: *Should we just put them back in?*
hunks.sol: *Should I just put them back in?*

hunks.baseline: Unfortunately, it didn’t happen.
hunks.sol: Unfortunately, neither got the chance.

hunks.baseline: Beyond the darkness fading away, a man appeared in a rush. His eyes were as cold as his expression as he surveyed the area, then asked Jin Taekyung,
hunks.sol: A man came surging out of the fading darkness. He surveyed the area with eyes as cold as his expression, then turned to Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: “Is this dark arts?”
hunks.sol: “Dark arts?”

hunks.baseline: At the answer that came without a pause, the man—Song Ilseom—lowered the blade dripping with blood.
hunks.sol: At the answer that came without a pause, Song Ilseom lowered his blood-dripping blade.

hunks.baseline: “Glad you’re alive. By the way, where’s Young Lady Ju?”
hunks.sol: “Glad you’re alive. Where’s Young Lady Ju?”

hunks.baseline: Song Ilseom hesitated for a moment, then added,

hunks.baseline: “The employer’s safety comes first.”
hunks.sol: Song Ilseom hesitated, then added, “The employer’s safety comes first.”

hunks.baseline: Unlike the three before her, Ju Hwaran ran toward Jin Taekyung without the slightest hesitation.
hunks.sol: Unlike the three before her, Ju Hwaran moved to run toward Jin Taekyung without the slightest hesitation.

hunks.baseline: More precisely, she would have—
If the third and fourth rifts hadn’t opened at the same time.
hunks.sol: She would have, too, if the third and fourth rifts hadn’t opened at the same time.

hunks.baseline: Cheongpung appeared with a voice that sounded nothing like his words. A shadow appeared right after him, as though it were one with the magical power, and let its actions speak for it.
hunks.sol: Cheongpung emerged sounding remarkably cheerful for someone who’d just said that. Behind him, a shadow appeared like a ghost, as though it were one with the magical power. It acted without a word.

hunks.baseline: A flash raced through the space, outstripping even sound.
hunks.sol: A flash crossed the space faster than sound.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung knocked aside the dagger, which had shot toward him with terrifying speed, and shrugged.
hunks.sol: Jin Taekyung knocked aside the dagger flying at him with terrifying speed and shrugged.

hunks.baseline: “One of the few things assassins and physicians have in common is that we must be suspicious of everything around us. The more suspicious we are, the fewer mistakes we make.”
hunks.sol: “Assassins and physicians have a few things in common. Being suspicious of everything around us is one of them. The more we question, the fewer mistakes we make.”

hunks.baseline: “I think I’m less suspicious of the reality I’m seeing, at least.”
hunks.sol: “At least I no longer doubt what I’m seeing is real.”

hunks.baseline: “I’m more suspicious of myself now, though. How did you wake up already?”
hunks.sol: “I’m beginning to doubt myself, though. How did you wake up already?”

hunks.baseline: “Well, I’m just normal. Anyone can do this with the Heavenly Martial Physique and martial arts like mine.”
hunks.sol: “Well, I’m nothing special. Anyone with the Heavenly Martial Physique and martial arts like mine could do it.”

hunks.baseline: At the two Master and Disciple’s mocking, arrogant replies, the Slaughter Saint squeezed his eyes shut. Just then, a person appeared from the fifth and final rift.
hunks.sol: The Slaughter Saint squeezed his eyes shut at the Master and Disciple’s mocking, arrogant answers. Just then, someone emerged from the fifth and final rift.

hunks.baseline: Unlike the others, she didn’t hurry or move stealthily. Her clothes and skin were untouched by a single drop of blood.
hunks.sol: Unlike the others, she neither hurried nor moved stealthily. Not a drop of blood stained her clothes or skin.

hunks.baseline: But Bow Saint’s eyes were different from usual.
hunks.sol: But the Bow Saint’s eyes were different.

hunks.baseline: It lasted only a moment, but a few people saw it clearly: the traces of intense emotion left in those clear, normally unshakable eyes.
hunks.sol: It lasted only a moment, but a few people saw it clearly: the traces of fierce emotion in eyes that were usually clear and unshakable.

hunks.baseline: Just as a wave that crashes against a reef can’t hide its white foam, that emotion left its mark somewhere in her eyes, black as the night sky.
hunks.sol: Just as a wave striking a reef can’t hide its white foam, that emotion had left its mark somewhere in her eyes, black as the night sky.

hunks.baseline: Before anyone could form a clear suspicion about what they’d just seen, the low-voiced conversation between a beggar and a hero reached everyone’s ears.
hunks.sol: Before anyone could make sense of what they’d seen, a low-voiced exchange between the beggar and the hero reached everyone’s ears.

hunks.baseline: “What, so it’s real?”
hunks.sol: “What? Is it real?”

hunks.baseline: “I told you it isn’t. Don’t go saying beggar-rag nonsense just because you’re the Successor Beggar.”
hunks.sol: “I told you it isn’t. Leave it to the Successor Beggar to talk like a filthy footwrap.”

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “No, it looks real to me, no matter how I look at it.”
hunks.sol: “No, it looks real to me.”

hunks.baseline: “I said it’s real dark arts.”
hunks.sol: “I said it’s *real dark arts*.”

hunks.baseline: “Ha, shit. Is that so?”
hunks.sol: “Ah, shit. Is it?”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin delivered the final blow to Gung Gibang, who was frowning.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin delivered the final blow to the frowning Gung Gibang.

hunks.baseline: “But dark arts can never be perfect. You gain power by abandoning the proper path. Look—we’re one person short. They must have managed to imitate everyone else, but not dared to try imitating that man.”
hunks.sol: “But dark arts can never be perfect. They grant power to those who abandon the proper path, but there’s always a flaw. Look—we’re one person short. They managed to imitate everyone else, but they must not have dared try that man.”

hunks.baseline: The people listening to the two suddenly realized something they’d completely forgotten.
hunks.sol: Everyone listening suddenly remembered something they’d forgotten.

hunks.baseline: Even now, after the final rift had closed, the Great Sir was nowhere to be seen.
hunks.sol: Even now, after the final rift had closed, Great Sir was nowhere to be seen.
